about_me.title: About Me
about_me.paragraph: I like building products that solve real problems. I enjoy bringing design, development, and simple ideas together to create useful experiences that are easy to use.
about_me.sub_paragraph: I like thinking through the whole path: understanding what a person needs, designing a clear solution, and building it so it works well. To me, a good product should help, solve, and make things simpler.
